storyline:

3879.8s: Both players pause briefly before next serve action, with Ma Long taking advantage of brief recovery window to reset stance confidently ahead of crucial point play.

4716.7s: Three athletes walk down steps away from podium after ceremony concludes, carrying trophies and flower bouquets representing their accomplishments at Tokyo 2020 Olympic table tennis final match.

4792.8s: Final shot captures group moving toward exit doors behind podium area as officials conclude formal recognition procedures marking end of historic tournament sequence at Tokyo Olympics venue.
